cv.name: Rania Haroon
cv.headline: Junior Software Developer: PostgreSQL, Python and TypeScript
cv.summary: Junior software engineer with two years of production TypeScript and PostgreSQL, plus Python data loading from an analytics internship. Cut a nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6 and loaded about 2 million rows a week into PostgreSQL.

bullets: Cut the nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6 by replacing row-by-row updates with set-based SQL and adding two partial indexes.
Built and maintain the invoicing service (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) that issues about 9,000 invoices a month for the company’s logistics clients.
Built the React (TypeScript) admin screens for refunds and credit notes, including role-based access checks on the API side.
Moved four services from a hand-built VPS setup to Docker Compose with health checks; wrote the runbook the on-call rotation now uses.
Wrote Python scripts that cleaned and loaded retail sales CSVs into PostgreSQL for the analytics team (about 2 million rows a week).
Added unit tests to the ingestion scripts (pytest), raising coverage of the loader module from 0 to 71%.

projects.name: ledger-lite
projects.description: A small double-entry bookkeeping API in TypeScript (Fastify, PostgreSQL) that enforces balanced journal entries with a database constraint.

projects.name: Bus Tracker Lahore
projects.description: A React + Leaflet map of Metro Bus stops with estimated arrival gaps from public timetables.

education.details: CGPA 3.4 / 4.0. Final-year project: offline-first attendance app for rural schools (React Native, SQLite).
